purpose: A conservative progress map. It counts bounded topics and their evidence states; it is not a percentage of game compatibility.

topics.title: Retail data-track baseline
topics.next_question: Establish whether installed files outside the disc tree are complete, including cabinet contents and non-disc components.

topics.title: CD audio-track comparison
topics.next_question: Determine whether the measured track-8 tail difference is audible or a mastering artifact.

topics.title: Installed-resource inventory
topics.next_question: Establish whether the mIC.exe palette loader and its direct caller at 0x00416979 execute at runtime, and classify the remaining generic binary formats.

topics.title: SRSC container and record table
topics.next_question: Establish record field meanings beyond observed selector comparisons, sample correlations, and the seek/read budget.

topics.title: SRSC selector 0x0102
topics.next_question: Identify the tail grammar or a producer/consumer that establishes its runtime meaning.

topics.title: SRSC selector 0x0302 candidate audio
topics.next_question: Establish actual cache-state dispatch and playback before treating bodies as game audio.

topics.title: SRSC selector 0x0501/0x0502 constructor diagnostics
topics.next_question: Establish whether the observed consumer executes and what, if anything, the raw fields, 52-byte rows, and opaque suffix represent.

topics.title: Database descriptors
topics.next_question: Establish the full grammar and runtime association without resolving embedded paths.

topics.title: Model point and group records
topics.next_question: Establish topology, materials, transforms, and visual output.

topics.title: Level selector (1,0,0)
topics.next_question: Resolve remaining fields, reference-pair scope, exceptional blocks, and discriminator role.

topics.next_question: Trace a producer or downstream consumer that establishes conditional-frame bodies.

topics.next_question: Verify displayed orientation, surface conversion, palette association, and color-key behavior visually.

topics.title: Checked binary-reading foundation

topics.title: Renderer and visual verification
